hardwareHubs.note: The UAF Makerspace offers CNC milling, 3D printing, laser cutting and small-batch production of 1 to 100+ units.
Anchorage MakerSpace is a roughly 3,600 square foot shop in Spenard.

makerspaces.name: UAF Makerspace
makerspaces.note: University lab in Duckering Room 345 with laser cutters, a desktop CNC and 3D printers, free to use.

makerspaces.name: Anchorage MakerSpace
makerspaces.note: About 3,600 square feet in Spenard, with a grant-funded laser-cutting class reported in 2017 (current equipment not confirmed).

events.name: Alaska Startup Week
events.note: Techstars Startup Week Alaska ran more than 50 events across the state in 2021.

events.name: Arctic Innovation Competition
events.note: UAF pitch competition with no entry fee that does not require a developed product.

programs.name: UAF Makerspace Network
programs.note: Offers design, prototyping and small-batch manufacturing services to researchers and inventors.

specialties.name: Seafood processing
specialties.note: Seafood is the state's main export after oil and natural gas, mainly salmon, cod, pollock and crab.

specialties.name: Oil and gas
specialties.note: Petroleum is one of the three main legs of the state economy.

specialties.name: Mining
specialties.note: Gold, zinc and other mining are listed among the state's industrial outputs.

support.name: Alaska MEP (UAA Business Enterprise Institute)
support.note: Alaska's NIST MEP center was hosted by UAA, and a November 2025 trade article says it was set to shut down on June 30 (status not confirmed on NIST).

support.name: Alaska Manufacturing Association
support.note: New trade group founded after the MEP closure to unify and advocate for Alaska manufacturers.
